title: Walia-LLM: Enhancing Amharic-LLaMA by Integrating Task-Specific and Generative Datasets
findings: Fine-tuning with a custom dataset for religious lyrics improved the base LLaMA-2-Amharic model's ability to perform these tasks. The Walia model showed notable improvement in completing religious lyrics compared to the base model, though GPT-4 still performed best overall on generation tasks.
